decisions.quote: We obtain a sample size close to the paper, with some countries having slightly more observations than the paper, suggesting that we may lack certain data-cleaning procedures during the replication. However, the results of our summary statistics are similar to those in the tables.
decisions.reason: Reconstructing the analysis from the raw data did not recover the exact reported sample sizes, summary statistics, or regression coefficients, even though the substantive significance pattern remained similar.

decisions.quote: Because of the time limit, we did not carry out any additional robustness checks.
decisions.reason: The authors only re-estimated the original baseline specification in Stata and Python and explicitly state that they did not conduct any additional robustness checks.

parent_objection: Axis1 first reply codes computational issues from close rather than exact reconstructed sample/statistics. Read exact codebook: negligible numerical differences are compatible with computationally reproducible; do not assume all discrepancies or changed sample sizes imply issues. Source says sample close, summary stats similar, main regressions significance/pattern consistent, effect magnitudes differ by small amounts and only nonsignificant coefficient directions differ. Table4 provides actual original and reconstruction values. Are central numbers recovered within negligible variation or materially unrecovered? Judge supplied tables and authors language, not successful substantive claim alone. Axis2 separately: no additional checks, only same baseline in Python/Stata. Return both requested axes; no third call.

shipped.title_o: Child Marriage Bans and Female Schooling and Labor Market Outcomes: Evidence from Natural Experiments in 17 Low- and Middle-Income Countries
shipped.outcome_quote: Computational: We obtain a sample size close to the paper, with some countries having slightly more observations than the paper, suggesting that we may lack certain data-cleaning procedures during the replication. However, the results of our summary statistics are similar to those in the tables. || Robustness: our results are similar to the original outcomes of the paper in terms of statistical significance and follow the same pattern. Though in some cases, the directions of the effects (not statistically significant) or the magnitudes of the effects differ by small amounts, we are able to obtain consistent results in general among the five outcome variables and six sample specifications.

blind_target.evidence_quote:
We replicate these findings by collecting the raw
data from the same sources as the paper and analysing the data following the procedures
described in the paper, without referring to the data and codes provided by the author.
blind_target.outcome_computational_quote:
Our
findings are consistent with the results of the paper in terms of the statistical significance of point
estimates and differ in magnitude by a negligible amount.
blind_target.outcome_robustness_quote:
Because of the time limit, we
did not carry out any additional robustness checks.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors judge numerical differences negligible. Running the same specification in two software packages is computational verification; no alternative substantive specifications were tested.
